parse.text:
Overview

Honey is a MythicalMythical unit that is an original character created by Gomu. She is obtainable through summons or through purchase of Bundles.

Evolving

Honey can evolve into Honey (Hive) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Honey is the first Original Character from this game.
  • Honey is one of the first banner units to be added to Anime Adventures since the re-release of the game.
  • Honey is the first mythic character that does NOT have an AOE because her AOE comes from her passive
  • Honey (Hive) has the lowest takedown requirement of any unit to evolve, only requiring 100.
  • Honey is currently the fastest Mythical unit in the game.
  • Mirrorblade is the most recomended relic due to her attack speed
  1. ↑ Takedowns refer to kills or assists
